source: Immutable accepted source components.centered_correction Float32[N,2], source model protocol3b3c; never the partial failed attempt
active: Native V and F branches both kept; their mapped candidate slots valid, actual availability1, distinct categoryIDs/classindices, true supported T>1; label-free and common across all roles/seeds
mapping: Always gather native V/F via branch_to_candidate and verify branch category equals mapped candidate category. CategoryID0 is valid; -1 denotes absent/negative only.
contrast: Original candidate correction difference retained in real arithmetic; F32 D only within declared rounding bound. No exactbit contrast claim.
deployment: Original formal T availability deployed per-seed q and original saved full_logits anchor. DenseCPUF32 sigmoid(old_logits+F32alpha*projected); projected0/inactive/alpha0 copy exact formal T q. OriginalE3 mixing/Gaussian/native COCO unchanged.
inactive: Only pre-Gaussian q/branch/class and original native s/bbox are unchanged. Gaussian score suppression can indirectly change final inactive output scores/ranks; no claim of final invariance.
diagnostics: Only native V or only native F branches with the exact formal T fixed q0, original kept/category/score/bbox, same Gaussian/COCO. Never read pairdelta and never add a missing branch. V/F candidates share availability-aware source-trained scorer, so this is not a completely material-free comparison.
